messages:
Ana (DevEx): LAN tonight at the office? I can host — got a 55" TV and a tiny 8-port switch. thinking ~7pm. who’s in? :grinning:
Matt: I’m down. can’t bring my PC but I’ll bring a steam deck + dock. do we have enough power outlets/tables?
Jules: I can bring my desktop + monitor. heads up my NIC is flaky sometimes (drops to 100mb). fine for most games but might be annoying for fast shooters.
Sasha: I’ve got an HDMI switch (4-in) and a couple of surge strips. also a small folding table. happy to bring all that. :thumbsup:
Ben (Infra): FYI building network has limited free ports in the patch panel. if we need >8 wired clients we should do a daisy chain or bring a travel router with AP mode. also shout if you need VLANs turned off (guest network) so Steam friends can see each other.
Ana (DevEx): Good call. @Ben can you run patch panel check around 5:30? don’t want a last-minute scramble.
Ben (Infra): Will do. I can also temporarily disable client isolation on the guest AP.
Matt: For the Steam Deck folks — do people want to try Remote Play or just native? handhelds + TV would be sweet.
Jules: Native for local multiplayer, Remote Play for anyone joining from home. if we do Remote Play, we should keep one machine as host and hardwire it.
Sasha: Also reminder — bring battery banks. the decks + controllers suck battery mid-session. I have a couple but not enough USB-C cables.
Ana (DevEx): I’ll add a small checklist in the thread:
```
- host machine (wired)
- 8-port switch
- HDMI switch + cables
- surge strips
- battery banks + cables
- 1 spare travel router (AP mode)
- folding table
- chairs
```
Matt: can someone grab a cheap ethernet splitter? i.e., a small unmanaged switch — makes setup easier.
Jules: I have a spare Netgear 5-port I can bring.
Ben (Infra): heads up about modem: building modem does weird double-NAT. if you need port stuff for hosting lobbies, I can put the host into DMZ for the night.
Sasha: Perfect. also can we do a poll for game picks? thinking: Smash, Helldivers, Rocket League, and an indie rotation.
Ana (DevEx): poll sounds good. I’ll post a quick emoji vote at 6pm.
router-bot: Network check scheduled by Ben at 17:30. Link: https://infra.local/check/lan-setup
Matt: sweet. see y’all at 7 — I’ll bring snacks if people want. :cookie:
Ana (DevEx): Legend. tag me if you need help carrying stuff in.
Sasha: I’ll bring extra USB-C cables and a mini HDMI adapter.
Jules: bringing the Netgear and a spare ethernet cable spool.
Ben (Infra): Patch panel looks fine — 6 open ports on the South rack. DM me if you need a reserved port.
Ana (DevEx): Awesome. thanks team! see you tonight :)
